extracted.name: Ginger Salmon
extracted.description: The wonderful natural flavor of salmon is greatly enhanced by the addition of a tangy glaze made with ginger, honey, and Dijon mustard.
instruction_lines: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
In a small bowl, blend olive oil, honey, Dijon mustard and ginger
Brush salmon fillets evenly with the olive oil mixture. Place in a medium baking dish. Bake 15 to 20 minutes in the preheated oven, until the fish flakes easily with a fork.
